sources.title: YNSScarSaiyan/simi-weights · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Public weights-only repository. No architecture or training source is stored here. SImi-2B is a custom Llama-style causal language model trained in JAX/Flax. This repository is the public parameter mirrorfor the student. It does not contain the private recovery snapshot, optimizer state, or source archive from YNSScarSaiyan/simi, and it is nota drop-in Transformers checkpoint.
